overall_goal: Boil the hibiscus drink on the stove while stirring it occasionally.

goals.description: Place the saucepan on the stove and cover it to boil
goals.rationale: The person lights the burner, places the saucepan on it, and covers it with a lid to start the boiling process.

goals.description: Open the saucepan and perform the initial stirring
goals.rationale: The person prepares a spoon, opens the lid, and stirs the drink for the first time.

goals.description: Continue stirring the drink and adjust the saucepan on the stove
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly stirs the contents of the saucepan, occasionally adjusting the pot's position on the hob.

goals.description: Perform further stirring and manage the saucepan lid
goals.rationale: The person performs additional stirring sessions while taking off and replacing the lid of the saucepan.
